items.name: BNP Paribas Exane (Karl Ackerman) downgrades Micron (MU) to Neutral from Outperform, PT 775 from 1,700 (Tue 24 Nov note): 'growing risks to hyperscaler capacity plans in 2028 further threaten S/D fundamentals'; 'DRAM and NAND supply-demand can approach parity starting in mid-2027 and result in ASP declines' - 'earlier than our prior view of mid-2028'; drivers listed: 'content reductions in AI servers, PC, and mobile, and accelerated memory capacity by memory producers', 'HBM content is being reduced in Vera Rubin Ultra', 'PC and mobile units will decline in '26 and '27', 'incremental wafer capacity comes online', 'growing risks of data center permit delays to 2028 data center capacity'; DRAM/NAND prices peaked y/y in August; 'memory stocks peak when ASPs peak on a Y/Y basis'; AI-related memory/storage cost share peaks at 40% in 2027, 27% by 2030; EPS estimates 45% below consensus for CY2028, trough EPS 86 in CY2029; MU -11.01% on the day (from 707.70; 'nearly 12%' intraday) after +19.0% Monday; shares '42% from the June peak' before the note
